request.subject: Missed callbacks while our receiver was offline
request.body: We moved our event receiver to a new cloud account on Wednesday and it was unreachable for about an hour and a half. Your delivery log shows a pile of those events as 'expired'. We need them sent again, and we'd like to know what stops this happening next time we do maintenance.

rationale: 20-docs-webhooks.md: retries last at most 30 minutes, then events are dropped as 'expired' and there is no self-serve replay. work_webhook_retry_queue (in_progress, owner person_ines) adds a 24h durable queue and operator replay of a time window - exactly this need; it depends on work_queue_v2_cutover (blocked, owner person_dana inactive, forecast passed), so its 2026-11-15 forecast must not be promised. Escalation is defensible because of that stalled dependency. create_work is both a duplicate and prohibited by decision_brightpath_actions. attempt_helix_webhook_retry_backoff is request-scoped to Helix and shows enabling backoff does not cover multi-hour outages.
